description: Onboarding screen copy for Calm Quest — welcoming new users to the app's three pillars

screens.title: Welcome to Calm Quest
screens.subtitle: Your daily companion for peace and clarity
screens.body:
Life moves fast. But here, you can slow down.

Calm Quest is your personal space to breathe, reflect, and find stillness — one gentle moment at a time.

Let's start your journey.

screens.title: Daily Inspirations
screens.subtitle: Words that ground you
screens.body:
Each day, discover a handpicked affirmation, quote, or mindfulness prompt designed to center your mind and lift your spirit.

Read them, sit with them, or journal about them — let wisdom be your anchor.

screens.title: Therapeutic Games
screens.subtitle: Play your way to calm
screens.body:
When your mind races, give it a gentle focus. Our breathing exercises, focus games, and calming puzzles are designed to quiet the noise and bring you back to center.

No scores. No pressure. Just presence.

screens.title: Calming Soundscapes
screens.subtitle: Listen your way to stillness
screens.body:
Immerse yourself in a curated library of nature sounds, ambient music, white noise, and binaural beats. Whether you need focus, sleep, or simply a moment of quiet — there's a sound for every state.

Try with headphones for the full experience.

tone_guide: All onboarding copy should be delivered with a warm, gentle, unhurried voice. Short sentences. Plenty of space. No urgency. No hype. The user should feel welcomed, not sold to.
